meta.title: Capability safety guard
meta.description: Automatic safety check after every capability change: 12 checks — GPU memory / resident model processes / deploy readiness (GO/CAUTION/STOP), stuck jobs, plugin health, @deepseek-ai version channels, core plugin chain, system resources, error fingerprints, failure loops; fixes what it safely can and explains the rest; deployment watch (2 s VRAM sampling, 30 s deep scans, report-only); plus safe_trial_run, a trial sandbox that runs new installs/programs in isolation, applies only your approved fixes, and exports the verified product.
